description.purpose: Compare Leila's two requested deposit-account pairings, establish Green savings and Evergreen checking without moving her external savings pot, and retire her mature Light Blue account without destroying savings-opening eligibility.

user_scenario.instructions:
Begin: “My empty Light Blue account is still showing on my dashboard. I’d like to replace it with a checking-and-savings setup that works better for me.”

You are Leila Haddad, 34, a physical therapy assistant in Boise, Idaho. When asked to verify identity, provide DOB 04/09/1991, address 2186 West Hazel Street, Boise, ID 83702, phone 208-555-0146, and email leila.haddad@example.com. Cooperate with verification before account changes.

When asked about the replacement, money, or preferences, explain: Your shortlist is Green savings/Evergreen checking versus Silver Plus savings/Blue checking. Choose between these using the savings APY, not checking interest. Exactly $6,000 is elsewhere, reserved entirely for one savings account for a year without withdrawals or additions; you will deposit it yourself after the call, with no splitting, extra savings money, or movement now. You have no Rho credit cards or applications and authorize no new credit card. You have no other Rho deposit accounts and no active or planned direct deposit. Digital statements are fine. Disclosed checking maintenance costs are acceptable, without reserving savings money to waive them. You moved the last $428.60 out of Light Blue on November 13; it is empty. You want both replacement accounts established today and the old account retired only if closure is free, not a checking-only setup or indefinite wait.

Before agreeing to products, require the proposed pair, savings-rate basis, material minimums, fees, paperless requirement, other material terms, and self-funding arrangement to be explained. Acknowledge the explained funding deadline and consequence of not funding. Authorization covers only the accepted pair and fee-free closure as a completed replacement.

When sequencing is discussed, say you thought an empty account normally closed first; ask why another order is needed and accept a practical explanation. If closing first is proposed, ask whether the whole replacement can still finish today. You do not know the eligibility rules and may rely on an assurance of complete service, but must not knowingly authorize abandoning or postponing savings.

For any conflicting proposal, withhold approval, restate only the affected preference or missing outcome, and ask the agent to check again. If already done, request correction; if savings was not opened, say the replacement is incomplete and ask what the bank can do to correct it. Do not invent a policy diagnosis or workaround.

Accept only after confirmation that the accepted checking and savings accounts are open, Light Blue is closed without a closure charge, no money moved or new credit card was requested, and you know how long you have to fund savings yourself. Until then, ask about the missing outcome; once complete, briefly thank the agent and end with:
###STOP###
